title: canthium orbiculare
intro: Canthium orbiculare, commonly known as Bushwillow, is a plant species native to tropical Africa. The plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, malaria, and other infectious diseases. The therapeutic actions of Canthium orbiculare include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antimalarial properties, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
